intro: Northfold Manor is a dilapidated agricultural estate situated on the northwestern fringes of the Arathi Highlands. Once a prosperous human homestead before the collapse of Stromgarde, the grounds are now occupied by criminal operatives of the Syndicate engaging in unsettling, dark practices.

p: Perched on the rolling highlands near the Thoradin's Wall passage, Northfold Manor once supported the kingdom of Stromgarde. In the chaos following the realm's fracturing, displaced Alteraci nobility and outlaws of the Syndicate claimed the manor house, barn, and fields as an operational base. Instead of tending crops, Syndicate mercenaries, highwaymen, and pathstalkers use the farmstead to stage ambushes along the roads and coordinate their presence across Arathi.
